DeployBot: [nightdash] ALERT: p99 latency +45% for 'model-x' on prod-nightly across runtime shard group A. spike started ~03:12 UTC.
Anya: saw the alert, correlates with last night's merge r3456? anyone on call can look?
Ben: grabbing profiler traces now. initial glance: KV hit rate drops at same time in dashboard, batching throughput also down.
Carla: batch size distribution shifted left (more small batches). Could be batching heuristic or KV-induced backpressure.
Dmitri: looked at the merge diff for r3456 — there's a prefetch heuristic tweak in runtime/prefetch.cc (shrunk window default). tagging @Anya @Ben
Anya: ok can we bisect to that commit quickly? if it's the prefetch change we should revert for canary.
Eva: FYI CI nightly perf job had a failing comparison too: http://ci.internal/reports/nightly/9876 — p99 regressed ~26% on macrobatch scenario.
Frank: uploaded a trimmed flamegraph from a prod trace: ``func_x 35%
kv_lookup 25%
select_kernel 20%
other 20%``
Ben: select_kernel time doubled after the merge. looks like we're running an extra kernel scoring pass per candidate.
Carla: stack traces show repeated compute_kernel_score() calls. appears O(n^2) when batch_count > 8 due to nested loop we introduced.
Dmitri: quick local revert of prefetch-window patch brings select_kernel latency back to baseline in my microbenchmark.
Anya: plan suggestion: 1) abort canary, 2) open revert PR for prefetch heuristic, 3) run CI perf job + nightdash smoke, 4) add regression unit test for kernel selector complexity, 5) rerollout. objections?
Eva: +1. I'll open the revert PR and attach perf diffs.
Frank: ready to run rollback when PR is merged: `./deploy rollback --canary=runtime-v2 --wait`
Carla: also add a guard in kernel selector to short-circuit when batch_count > threshold to avoid O(n^2) behavior until we fix scoring.
Ben: I'll instrument more detailed metrics for select_kernel (histograms by batch_size) and KV hit latency to confirm root cause.
Dmitri: creating PR now: https://git.redwood/r/repo/pull/4572 (revert prefetch window shrink).
DeployBot: deploy: canary abort requested by Anya at 2026-03-18T04:12:49Z.
Anya: thanks all — Eva/Dmitri please follow through on the PR + CI. Ben/Frank monitor dashboards and post updates here. I'll ping SRE if rollout rollback impacts infra. :thumbsup:
